title: execute or deny rollback drill after controlled canary activation evidence

files.role: RC9 controlled rollback drill gate evaluation and denial projection script
controlled rollback handoff for support and recovery binding

criteria: The projection script consumes RC9-022 controlled activation denial evidence and handoff before evaluating rollback.
The rollback PlanSpec requirement records exact rollback approval, AgentCore rollback PlanSpec, and SecurityExecutionEngine rollback approval as required and unbound.
The rollback gate report records rollback-denied with rollback_execution_allowed=false and rollback_execution_performed=false.

The rollback denial evidence covers upstream external object, drift, installer fetch, target enrollment, exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine, activation-not-performed, remote fleet, and rollback authorization blockers.
The controlled rollback handoff moves the workflow to RC9-031 while support upload, recovery execution, rollback execution, and remote dispatch remain denied.

The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and does not mutate install, activation, rollback, active slot, boot metadata, persistent state, active artifact set, production ring, support upload, or remote dispatch state.
